# edh-top-8 (Commander lane edh-top): play lands and cast spells from among a group of exiled cards (also for free), an option actor named by "they", an opponent choosing a nonland card exiled this way and casting two of the others, "as long as you have sacrificed ... you may play cards exiled with ~", separating a player's permanents into piles. After editing: npm run cards -- fixtures

Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor
Plargg and Nassari
